verdict.rationale: Together AI documents a public REST API callable from any language, with official Python and TypeScript SDKs, a published OpenAPI 3.1 spec, and a per-endpoint API reference generated from that spec. It is also OpenAI-compatible, so existing clients work by changing only the API key and base URL. The probe 404s at JSON OpenAPI paths are explained by the spec being published as openapi.yaml, so they do not contradict it. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the API reference's depth beyond a brief community mention of the Python API.
